Question Choices: Fill: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One exterior angle measures $68^\circ$. What is the measure of the corresponding interior angle in degrees?
Hints: Corresponding angles are in the exact same position at each intersection
Solution: Corresponding angles occupy the same position at the two intersections. Since the lines are parallel they are equal, so the other angle is 68°.

Question Choices: Fill: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. If one interior angle is $110^\circ$, what is the measure of the alternate interior angle in degrees?
Hints: Alternate interior angles are on opposite sides of the transversal inside the parallel lines
Solution: Alternate interior angles on opposite sides of the transversal are equal when the lines are parallel. Therefore the other angle is 110°.

Question Choices: Fill: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One angle formed is $47^\circ$. Find the measure of its supplementary angle in degrees.
Hints: Supplementary angles add up to 180 degrees
Solution: The requested pair is supplementary, so x+47=180°. Thus x=133°.

Question Choices: Fill: Two angles $(7x + 9)^\circ$ and $(4x + 60)^\circ$ form a pair of vertical angles. Find $x$.
Hints: Vertical angles are opposite each other and are exactly equal
Solution: Vertical angles are equal: (7 × x + 9)=(4 × x + 60). Collect variable terms and solve to get x=17. Substitution gives 128° in BOTH expressions, so the equality checks.

Question Choices: Fill: In triangle ABC, angles measure $(4x - 10)^\circ$, $(3x + 5)^\circ$, and $(x + 15)^\circ$. Find the measure of angle A (the first angle).
Hints: All three angles in a triangle must add up to 180 degrees
Solution: Triangle angles total 180°: ((4 × x - 10))+((3 × x + 5))+((x + 15))=180. Combine like terms and solve to get x=85/4. The three angle measures are 75, 275/4, 145/4 degrees, all positive and totaling 180. Requested angleA=(4 × x - 10)=75°.

Question Choices: Fill: An isosceles triangle has two equal base angles of $40^\circ$. Find the vertex angle in degrees.
Hints: The three angles must add up to 180 degrees
Solution: Two equal base angles each measure 40°. Vertex angle=180−2(40)=100°. Check: 40+40+100=180°.

Question Choices: Fill: An exterior angle of a triangle measures $145^\circ$. One remote interior angle is $55^\circ$. Find the other remote interior angle.
Hints: The exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles
Solution: The exterior angle equals the sum of remote interior angles: 55+x=145. Therefore x=90°. The adjacent interior angle is 35°; all three interior angles total 180°.
